pages.text: Altered from $(5)Projectile Protection$(), $(4)Corporeality$() increases resistance against non-magic attacks that ignore the armor worn. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Protection$(), $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(5)Projectile Protection$(), $(4)Algid Resistor$(), $(4)Atheism$() and $(4)Vigor$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Corporeality is for most people useless. There aren't many sources of damage that, while being able to pierce armor, couldn't still be protected against with the use of the Protection enchantment for example. However, one of the few dangers that Corporeality is the only defense against is the Void. This execration is ideal for dealing against threats that are meta-physical in their nature.
